objective: Retrospective finite native terminal envelopes and conditional gate break-even

operationalFacts.statement: R26 real-map contraction does not itself establish finite native quality. Saved native last steps permit point-specific exact rational defect bounds.
Residual/contraction convergence analyses already exist. New scope is native R26 warm/reset terminal pairs plus observed one-step defects, not a new contraction theorem.
R26 guarded reduced ticks8.20% but component CPU increased70.31%; stored timing alone only supports conditional break-even arithmetic.
